description: This PHP source file manages the display of a subpanel within the SuiteCRM system, handling request validation, setting up the subpanel object, and rendering its output, including header and footer management.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Represents the subpanel component responsible for retrieving configuration and rendering the subpanel content.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used to render the subpanel dynamically.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the action buttons associated with the subpanel.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the subpanel data, either as a count or full list, based on parameters.
